ScrubFrame.doc: Logical tape position for a bind plan. Progress is clamped 0..1.

WaitBags.doc: Direct-sibling partition under wait. Nested nodes are not flattened.

WaitClock.doc: Wait orchestration clocks. ``enter_t`` is when direct enters start.

_emit_track.signature: (node: Mapping[str, Any], t0: int, events: list[Event], counts: Mapping[str, int]) -> int

_play_node.signature: (node: Mapping[str, Any], t0: int, events: list[Event], counts: Mapping[str, int]) -> int

_play_phase.signature: (phase: Mapping[str, Any], t0: int, events: list[Event], counts: Mapping[str, int]) -> int

_play_wait.signature: (kids: list[Mapping[str, Any]], t0: int, events: list[Event], counts: Mapping[str, int]) -> int

_wait_run.signature: (kids: list[Mapping[str, Any]], t0: int, events: list[Event], counts: Mapping[str, int]) -> WaitClock

explain.doc: Human schedule. Same order as the reference player.
explain.signature: (plan: Mapping[str, Any], *, counts: Mapping[str, int] | None=None) -> str

frames.doc: Headless SVG schedule strip for CI / docs. No browser required.
frames.signature: (plan: Mapping[str, Any], *, width: int=640, height: int=120, counts: Mapping[str, int] | None=None) -> str

interpret.doc: Deterministic start/end schedule. Sorted by (t, event, target).
interpret.signature: (plan: Mapping[str, Any], *, counts: Mapping[str, int] | None=None) -> list[Event]

partition_wait.doc: Split wait siblings into frozen bags. Missing role is enter (IR default).

scrub.doc: Seek a plan's logical tape. ``progress`` is 0..1 (clamped).
scrub.signature: (plan: Mapping[str, Any], progress: float, *, counts: Mapping[str, int] | None=None) -> ScrubFrame

span_ms.signature: (plan: Mapping[str, Any], *, counts: Mapping[str, int] | None=None) -> int

wait_clocks.doc: Wait bags + clocks for a plan. ``enter_t`` matches interpret enter starts.
wait_clocks.signature: (plan: Mapping[str, Any], *, t0: int=0, counts: Mapping[str, int] | None=None) -> WaitClock
